title: Vendor On-Call & Reimbursement Quick Log
content:
Overview:
Quick scratchpad for vendor on-call handoffs, small reimbursements, and conference-day cash flows. Meant to live in my Drive as the single page of truth for vendors when I’m traveling or out-of-office. Use this to avoid repeated Slack threads.

Top priorities when on-call with vendors:
- Ensure vendor contact is reachable and confirm payment method before 8:30am event day.
- Capture receipts immediately (photo + annotate). Google Drive folder: /shared_drives/events/vendor-receipts/YYYY-MM (I upload under my personal copy if network flaky).
- Track petty cash float: usually $250 for booth incidentals. Count at start and end of day and log in sheet (quick cash log below).

Vendor contact cheat-sheet (save these numbers to phone + Slack):
- Exhibit Setup: BrightLine Logistics, contact Priya Sharma (mobile: +1-415-555-0182, email: priya@brightline.co). Backup: ops@brightline.co
- AV / Microphones: SoundLine Rentals, Samir Patel rep (mobile: +1-408-555-6620). Slack: @samir-soundline
- Catering liaison (light bites): CaféFlux, Lucia G (office: +1-212-555-9033). Send order confirmation screenshot to #events-catering channel.
- Badge printing: QuickBadges Inc, Jordan R. (badge admin: badges@quickbadges.io).

Typical reimbursable categories (for quick tagging in expense form):
- Vendor emergency purchase (e.g., power strip, gaffer tape) -> tag: vendor-emergency
- Taxi/ride for vendor staff -> tag: vendor-transport
- Last-minute catering top-up -> tag: catering-add
- Petty cash float replenishment -> tag: petty-cash

Receipt capture standard (do this immediately):
1) Photograph receipt in good light; crop to only the amount + vendor name.
2) Annotate on phone: write event name + why purchased (e.g., "Booth A3 cable replacement").
3) Upload to Drive folder and rename: YYYYMMDD_vendorname_amount_DESC.jpg (e.g., 20260305_brightline_23.45_powerstrip.jpg).
4) Add one-line entry to this doc under "Daily cash log" (see below) and to the reimbursement spreadsheet.

Email template for vendor reimbursement (copy/paste):
Subject: Reimbursement request: [Vendor] — [Amount] — [Event]
Hi [Finance contact],

Please process reimbursement for the below vendor expense linked in Drive: [drive link]. Details: [Vendor name], [amount], [date], [why]. Approver: [Ops lead].

Thanks,
[Your name]

Quick cash log (use abbreviated entries during event):
- 2026-03-05 | Start float $250 | Notes: sealed envelope w/ counter sign: Jordan R
- 2026-03-05 | 13:20 | -$23.45 BrightLine | power strip | upload: 20260305_brightline_23.45_powerstrip.jpg
- 2026-03-05 | 16:05 | -$12.00 CafeFlux | coffee reorder | upload: 20260305_cafeflux_12.00_coffee.jpg
- 2026-03-05 | End float $214.55 | hand-counted after close

On-call handoff checklist (5-min swap):
- Notify next on-call in #events-oncall with vendor summary + urgent issues (tag @next).
- Confirm receipt folder is synced and share Drive link with vendor contact.
- Transfer physical float envelope and get a quick photo of serial numbers on cash if >$100.
- Note any outstanding invoices and whether they were paid on card or cash.

Known pain points / TODOs:
- Need a simple QR code that vendors can scan to upload receipts directly to the folder (low friction). Action: follow up with dev-tools (ticket: JIRA-EXP-98).
- Finance sometimes rejects descriptions for being too terse. Add a small form field checklist for "why" (booth, travel, catering, misc) in the next reimbursement template.
- Confirm tax handling for foreign vendors (VAT receipts): contact legal/compliance for note.

Fuzzy rules I always follow (notes to self):
- If vendor asks for cash advance >$200, escalate to Ops lead and document approval in Slack thread.
- Never reimburse personal meals for vendor staff unless pre-approved. Use pre-order catering instead.
- For tips/payments made in local currency: convert using event-day card exchange rate and attach screenshot from card app.

Quick links & references:
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVENTS/Vendor+Oncall+Runbook
- Finance reimbursement form: https://finance.redwood.ai/forms/reimburse
- Expense policy summary (one-pager): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=98123

End note: this is intentionally terse. If anything unexpected happens, take a photo and write one line in Slack immediately — details can be filled in later in the reimbursement form. Keep receipts organized by date and vendor, and keep a record of approvals in Slack threads for audit.
